#summary Implementation examples

= Examples =

The examples below are found in SVN within the [http://code.google.com/p/amfast/source/browse/trunk/examples examples] directory. They implement a simple contact manager with data persisted by [http://www.sqlalchemy.org/ SqlAlchemy] and [http://www.sqlite.org/ SqlLite].

The example code is based on the [http://pyamf.org/wiki/SQLAlchemyAdapter PyAmf SQLAlchemy adapter example].

== !CherryPy Example ==

Use [http://www.cherrypy.org/ CherryPy] web framework to serve the example address book over http with the following command:
{{{
python addressbook/python/cp_server.py
}}}

== Twisted Example ==
Use [http://twistedmatrix.com/trac/ Twisted] web framework to serve the example address book over http with the following command:
{{{
twistd -noy addressbook/python/cp_server.py
}}}
